title: gh repo view --json ${field} --jq .${field}
description: The checkout's repository, ${field} nameWithOwner or url, which kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:repo, forge/github:repo-url), which `modules/bash/tracker/forge.sh` (tracker/forge:url, tracker/forge:new-url) reaches through the forge.
